name: Cum num
summary: Cúm núm is a round-shelled crab from Sa Huỳnh with firm, rich, sweetly fragrant meat, at its best in lunar months six to eight. Steam it with beer, fry it with salt, grill it, or cook it with rice noodles.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the meat firm, rich, and sweetly fragrant.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: steam with beer, fry with salt, grill, or cook with rice noodles.
where: Sa Huỳnh, on the southern coast.
seoDescription: Cúm núm, the round-shelled crab of Sa Huỳnh, firm and rich, best in lunar months six to eight. 80,000 VND a kilogram.
